requirements.statement: Bind entry to PR 11 head, squash commit, tree, parent, exact-head CI, immutable artifact, and post-merge main CI.
Byte-verify the frozen Stage 2 authorities and preserve all accepted v1 and v2 schemas.
Load only the digest-bound active v2 registry, validate its exact family set, schema identifiers, dialect, and offline references.
Reject malformed UTF-8, BOM, duplicate or NFC-colliding keys, floats, exponent numbers, non-finite values, surrogates, and out-of-range integers.
Canonicalize strings to NFC, timestamps to RFC 3339 UTC, objects by sorted keys, and digests over the frozen exclusion fields.
Require byte-size, SHA-256, record count, LF-only JSON Lines framing, and one LF byte for an explicitly declared zero-record object.
Validate and digest-bind reconciliation policy before processing any source record.
Validate manifest-to-policy binding, exact four-family inventory, run identity, and exact supplied-object set.
Confine local reads beneath a resolved root, reject traversal and symlinks, and treat stable read failure as admission failure.
Derive the frozen source identity and business digest for every admitted source record.
Treat identical redelivery as replay and reject identity reuse with changed business content.
Commit policy, manifest, and source replay state only after the complete bundle passes every admission check.
Use checked signed 64-bit integer operations for every admission-time amount and aggregate.
Reject unbalanced journals and preserve the one-clearing-line semantic annotation for later reconciliation.
Derive exact transaction and settlement reconciliation keys from the frozen component sets.
Reject cross-source currency-domain conflicts before reconciliation.
Normalize bank settlement references with NFC and outer trimming only; preserve case and punctuation.
Reject settlement-identity and bank-allocation ambiguity while retaining unknown references for Stage 5 classification.
Keep production admission independent from the reference oracle, Spark, AWS, network, persistence, proof, case, and revision execution.
Return deterministic immutable admitted values or an owned admission reason and never emit an authoritative proof.
Pass full-suite tests, exact Stage 3 statement and branch coverage, targeted semantic mutations, and two clean Python 3.11.13 runs.
Require exact-head draft-PR CI, immutable evidence inspection, squash merge, and independent main CI before Stage 3 promotion.
